recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is; no core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-3545 unless the work group reopens ImagingStudy scope wording more broadly.
issue_request: FHIR-3545 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for DSTU1 and asked to update the ImagingStudy resource description so it represents content produced in a DICOM imaging study, rather than a manifest of an arbitrary set of SOP Instances that might span multiple studies.
initial_application: The Jira-tagged commit e621d20623aabcc8c4ceddf6fc115cc185c914c0 applied FHIR-3545 to the then-authoritative ImagingStudy spreadsheet by replacing manifest wording with the DICOM-study description.
additional_context: ImagingStudy is active in source/fhir.ini. Current source/imagingstudy/structuredefinition-ImagingStudy.xml describes a DICOM imaging study with series and SOP Instances in a common context, and source/imagingstudy/imagingstudy-introduction.xml states that an ImagingStudy provides information on a single DICOM imaging study and that one ImagingStudy resource SHALL reference one DICOM Study. Later R6 work in FHIR-50769 retained that scope, while FHIR-50771, already on the combined branch, aligned the root definition to the current resource description and removed the older local modality sentence.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current build-scoped source satisfies the semantic correction requested by FHIR-3545, and restoring the old modality sentence would be redundant with current modality elements and inconsistent with later accepted ImagingStudy wording.
